title: Implement the users HTTP handler
prompt: Implement createUsersHandler(users) in src/handler.js. It returns a node:http-style (req, res) handler: GET /users answers 200 with a JSON array of the users and a JSON content type, any other path answers 404 with { error: "not found" }, and a non-GET request to /users answers 405 with { error: "method not allowed" }. Do not start a server and do not edit the tests.
